summary: This bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to prohibit federal immigration enforcement officers from searching private property without a judicial warrant, except with consent or in exigent circumstances.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to impose restrictions on federal law enforcement officers conducting immigration enforcement activities, requiring judicial warrants for searches of private property except in specific circumstances. This makes immigration enforcement more difficult, aligning with the 'More immigration' end of the spectrum.
